name: Idol Worship
overview: Scripture clearly commands exclusive devotion to the one true God, forbidding the worship of any other gods or idols, as emphasized in Exodus 20:3 and Leviticus 19:4. Idols, described as man-made objects of silver and gold in Psalms 115:4, represent a false and lifeless alternative to God’s sovereignty. The law prohibits creating or bowing down to graven images or standing stones (Leviticus 26:1), underscoring that idolatry is a serious offense. Colossians 3:5 further reveals that idolatry extends beyond physical idols to include sinful desires such as covetousness, identifying it as a heart issue that must be mortified in the believer’s life.
